answer: Each identity must lock a bond, called a river, before it can post or attest. Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so an adversary cannot recover it by rotating identities. A single wander checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Forging 346 aliases thus costs 205 bonds held for 6 days each, plus the shale attestations those aliases can never earn. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
